name: Conflux
blurb: Canberra's literary speculative-fiction convention, covering science fiction, fantasy and horror writing since 2004.
notes: Marked inactive: the homepage's only content is a notice that 'Conflux 20: Beyond the Abyss', planned for Oct 2-6, 2026, 'will no longer take place as scheduled' due to 'unfortunate circumstances beyond control', with refunds promised and 'more information to follow' - no future edition is announced. 'last' is the previous, successfully-held edition: Conflux 19 ran Oct 3-6, 2025 in Canberra with guests of honour Kirstyn McDermott, James Bradley, Freya Marske and Elise Miller (chaired by Cat Sparks), per web search of fan reports; exact venue not confirmed within budget so left blank. Organizer confirmed directly on-site: the page title itself is 'CONFLUX INC. - Home'.
